explanationMd: Use x²−y²=(x−y)(x+y). Substitute 52=4(x+y), so x+y=13. The identity avoids solving separately for both variables.

distractorRationale.b: This introduces an unnecessary factor of 2.
distractorRationale.c: This subtracts the two given quantities rather than factoring.
